name: ExS-TIA
source:
The form of Marina when she uses the PP (Physical Photon) Device to transform. Her physical abilities have been increased by tenfold, and she has the ability to destroy magical barriers and fight against the invaders from another world. Her weapon, Gunblade ExS-Saber, can also alternate forms between a sword and a gun.
Special move: Photon Punisher.
